newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-INJURED SMALL OUT OF DURBAN TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-INJURED SMALL OUT OF DURBAN TEST.

text.p: Springbok wing James Small has been ruled out of Saturday's second test against the British Lions in Durban because of a recurring hamstring strain.
"James Small was sent for a test at the Sports Science Institute in Cape Town on Monday and he injured the hamstring again," Springbok spokesman Herman Coetzee said on Tuesday.
"We're not sure at the moment how long it will take for him to recover."
Small damaged his hamstring during South Africa's one-off test against Tonga earlier this month.
Centre Japie Mulder is also doubtful. His place will depend on a final check-up by a Johannesburg specialist later on Tuesday.
